blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — Police operatives arrested a high-value individual and seized about 140 grams of suspected illegal drugs valued at P952,000 during a buy-bust operation in Barangay Cogon, Panitan, Capiz, on Tuesday night, Oct. 13. The suspect was identified by authorities through the alias “Boss,” 30, a resident of Panitan. According to police reports, the operation was executed around 9:38 p.m. following weeks of continuous intelligence gathering and surveillance targeting key personalities involved in the local illegal drug trade. “Boss” was caught in the act of selling a sachet of suspected shabu to an undercover police officer acting as a poseur […]...
